notes.title: 2025/APR/14 (MON) Bug Fix

[h1]20250414 Patch Notes[/h1]


[h2][Patch Notes][/h2]

[u][h3]Optimizations[/h3][/u]

[/list]

[list]
[*]New: Added the ability to hide the UI during play via right-clicking your mouse.

Thank you.

notes.title: 2025/APR/08 (TUES) Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Announcing Bug Fixes & Upcoming Patches

Hello,

We're happy to report that the update is now live.

The patch notes are below.

In addition, we are currently experiencing optimization issues that are causing long loading times and intermittent lag.
We are working on a fix for this and hope to have it fully resolved this week.

Thank you


[Patch Notes]

**In-Game Staging**.

- We've fixed some standing not appearing in the game.
- Fixed a bug where standing facial expressions would display incorrectly.
- Fixed mismatches between some lines of dialog and voices.
- Fixed motion in some comic performances.
- Fixed an error that caused unnecessary extra spaces in the log (line log) window.

**UI

- Fixed certain resources being broken.
- Fixed some inconsistencies in the UI positioning of lobby text.
- Improved lobby text blurring.
- Improved title positioning in chapter selections.
- Improved text readability in chapter selections.
- Improved the positioning of slow and fast text in General Settings.
- Improved image readability in the text output preview in General Settings.
- Improved positioning of subheadings in General Settings.
- Improved the positioning of gaps between settings in the General settings.
- Improved the visibility of the voice volume image in the Acoustics settings.
- Improved the visibility of the voice volume image in the voice volume manipulation UI in the acoustic settings.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: In Between All Times Release & Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Studio Elysian.

In Between All Times has finally been released.

First of all, we sincerely apologize for the disappointment caused by the lack of English support at this time.

But unfortunately English Version for IBAT is currently still in Development and will need time to have a proper english translation for the game.

We will further update you on our English Localization Process.

Our game, In Between All Times, was originally designed with English translation and localization in mind.
But during our translation process, we faced many errors and need to take time to fix them.

It was never our intention to mislead players.

we are currently preparing an English version and plan to release it as soon as possible. We understand the importance of clear communication and regret that this information was not more prominently shared earlier.

Thank you for your patience, and we truly appreciate your interest in our game.

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Released!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that 'In Between All Times' will be participating in the Steam Next Festival from February 25th to March 4th!

Currently you can play the story up to the prologue.
This is a rough Demo and other features and will be added / modified in time-by-time with steady updates!

Thank you!
